game_concept: A arcade set in Mystic Forest – Druid Grove, the druids' grove: the forest ranger must handle mischievous sprites while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Range Runner: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the forest ranger moves exactly n steps toward the herb garden.
theme: Mystic Forest – Druid Grove: the druids' grove
core_gameplay_loop: In Druid Grove, repeat each round: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the forest ranger moves exactly n steps toward the herb garden. Each round, a new dewdrops challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the steps_left value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 150 points of dewdrops by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 150, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Range Runner
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Runner' (Week 5 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Druid Grove'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how steps_left changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous sprites in Druid Grove.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 150 within 55 seconds.
